name: Amaran Lights
author: ttiimmaahh
description: Control amaran and Aputure lights from the Omarchy bar: power, brightness, and colour temperature, with an Elgato Control Center style panel.

barWidget.description: Power, brightness and colour temperature for amaran lights

schema.label: Daemon host
schema.description: Host running the amaran BLE daemon. Point this at another machine to drive the lights from a Mac or an ESP32 bridge.

schema.label: API key
schema.description: Optional. Must match the apiKey in the daemon's lights.json.

schema.label: Daemon directory
schema.description: Where the amaran BLE daemon and its key-bearing lights.json live. Used by the panel's setup button.

schema.label: Minimum colour temperature (K)
schema.description: Warm end of the temperature slider. 2700K suits the amaran Verge; older amaran fixtures reach 2500K.

schema.label: Maximum colour temperature (K)
schema.description: Cool end of the temperature slider. 6500K suits the amaran Verge; some fixtures reach 7500K.

schema.label: Hide from the bar when the daemon is down
